title: Scalar extension of a mixed total tensor
statement: Let R, A, Aq be commutative rings in one universe with compatible R -> A -> Aq algebra structures [def-weil-module-base-change]. Let Q be an A-module cochain complex and F an R-module cochain complex. Define C=Tot(Q tensor_A (A tensor_R F)) and Cq=Tot((Aq tensor_A Q) tensor_Aq (Aq tensor_R F)) [def-pc-mixed-total-tensor]. There is an Aq-linear chain isomorphism theta:Aq tensor_A C -> Cq which, in the (p,q) diagonal summand, sends 1 tensor (x tensor (1 tensor y)) to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). No flatness or derived categories are assumed. The termwise extension and restriction functors are those of def-pc-ring-tensor-cohomology.

proof.text: Use Mathlib ModuleCat.instMonoidalExtendScalars (cotensorator delta, whose pure-tensor formula is extendScalars_delta_tmul), followed by extendScalarsComp, to construct the Aq-linear mixed module isomorphism. Scalar-tower equality identifies the composite R -> A -> Aq with R -> Aq. Prove its naturality in both module variables using delta_natural_left/right, scalar-extension composition naturality, and whisker exchange. Its generator formula follows from extendScalarsComp_hom_app_one_tmul and cancellation by the inverse isomorphism.

HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents, twice, turns the natural mixed module isomorphism into an isomorphism of bicomplexes. Extension is additive by extendRestrictScalarsAdj.left_adjoint_additive and preserves coproducts as a left adjoint. Use source-library HomologicalComplex2.mapTotalIso and total.mapIso to obtain the total-complex isomorphism. map_iota_mapTotalXIso_inv and iotaTotal_map identify its action on diagonal inclusions; the mixed module generator formula then gives the asserted pure-tensor equation.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_mixedTotalTensor_scalarExtension
    (Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) :
    ∃ θ : (extend A Aq).obj
        (((ModuleCat.mixedTotalTensor (algebraMap R A)).obj Q).obj F) ≅
      ((ModuleCat.mixedTotalTensor (algebraMap R Aq)).obj ((extend A Aq).obj Q)).obj F,
    ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n) (x : Q.X p) (y : F.X q),
      θ.hom.f n ((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq]
        ((HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor Q F
          (ModuleCat.mixedTensor (algebraMap R A)) (.up ℤ) p q n h)
            (x ⊗ₜ[A] ((1 : A) ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R A] y)))) =
      (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor ((extend A Aq).obj Q) F
        (ModuleCat.mixedTensor (algebraMap R Aq)) (.up ℤ) p q n h)
          (((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[A,algebraMap A Aq] x) ⊗ₜ[Aq]
            ((1 : Aq) ⊗ₜ[R,algebraMap R Aq] y))
